VBO:0201286.summary: The Springbatt is a Springer Spaniel–Basset cross developed through successive generations at Manorroy. The kennel dates its work to 2003 and describes foundation dogs from working Springer and show Basset lines. Breeding later Springbatts to one another made this a continuing program, with individual dogs differing in both manner and appearance.
VBO:0201286.shortDescription: A Springer Spaniel–Basset cross developed at Manorroy from 2003, with later generations bred within the program.
